### 1. Project

Hale Capital intends to extend Warehouse (Class 7b) and Mezzanine office (Class 5) at 145-151 Arthur St, Homebush West NSW (Strathfield).

|---|---|---|

| Building: Warehouse: Class 7b, 2,135 m² GFA; Mezzanine office: Class 5, 215 m² GFA | Local government area: Strathfield | Procurement route: Traditional lump sum |
| Gross floor area: To be confirmed | Site area: 31,720 m² | Regulated design applies: Not known |
|  | Planning pathway: Development application (DA) |  |

Conditions that apply: Work to an existing building; Parts with different NCC classes; Building over or next to a water authority asset; Existing on-site detention to keep or modify; Use generates heavy vehicle movements.
Conditions that do not apply: Delivered in stages; Several buildings or a campus.
Conditions not yet known: Heritage item or conservation area; Connecting with Country input required; Site stays occupied or operating during the works; Community consultation required; Green Star or NABERS target set; Client wants the consultant to administer the construction contract.

Information provided: 12 current documents in the project register, listed in the issue record

### 5. Terms

- Engagement is under AS 4122-2010 as amended by the client's special conditions (attached); your own terms do not apply. List any change you propose to the agreement in R6.
- Only a written instruction from the client's representative authorises extra scope, work beyond an allowance or a fee change; work without one is not paid.
- Each stage ends at client sign-off, which sets the baseline for later stages. Design development within the brief is not a variation; a client change after sign-off is assessed under the agreement.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Invoice monthly against stage progress; payment within 30 days, not dependent on any authority approval.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Answers to scope questions go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.

### Returnable schedules: reply using this structure only

R2 Deliverables list: Each deliverable with its format, stage, review rounds and recipient; whether editable files are included and what reliance others may place on them. Drawing list: the sheets you expect at planning, tender and construction, with titles.
R3 Hourly rates: Excl. GST, for work authorised in writing beyond the allowances. Roles: Principal or Director · Associate or Senior architect · Project architect · Architect · Graduate or Technician · Interior designer · Administration.
R4 Team: Named lead, % time by stage, subconsultants; resources must match R7. Named director, project lead and project architect, with registration numbers.
R5 Experience: Two or three comparable projects in the last five years, each with a referee. Choose projects of the same use and work type.
R6 Departures: Each departure from sections 2–5 or the agreement: clause or item, proposed change, effect on fee and time; or "nil". A general exclusion not listed here is non-compliant.
R7 Program: Weeks by stage, separating your time, authority time and the dates you need inputs.
R8 Insurance and compliance: PI $20 million and PL $20 million with insurer and expiry; workers compensation; quality, safety and environmental systems (ISO 9001, 45001, 14001 or an equivalent you describe); conflicts of interest.
R9 Reimbursables: "Included in the fee" (preferred), or each item with its rate.
